request: Distinguish Alpine registry DNS from HTTPS egress in existing nonprivileged Docker container

bounded_host_request.command: sh -c 'docker image inspect node:22-alpine >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 70; docker run --rm --pull never node:22-alpine sh -c "nslookup dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org >/dev/null 2>&1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 81; docker run --rm --pull never node:22-alpine sh -c "wget -q -T 10 -O /dev/null https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 82; exit 0'
